Home / Museum Ship Reports / Submarine S-56 / Krasny Vympel, Vladivostok

Location: 6900091, Primorski area, Vladivostok, Russia

Visited: 19 September 2015

S-56 is a pre-war Russian submarine that has been preserved as a museum a short walk from downtown Vladivostok. It is well-preserved and well-presented, although much of the propulsion machinery is no longer present.

Nearby (across the road) the old naval auxiliary Krasny Vympel is moored and also open to visitors.
